title: Certify completed-error recovery for the retimed P104 dual
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2725's exact retimed P104 dual erases eight ideally zero private fields. Completed-operation errors can leave nonzero residuals, so exact-grid execution alone does not establish rounded cleanup. This package supplies a source-bound conditional recovery lemma and a separate error-response check for that literal word.

The all-cut bound is `E <= 5534*u*B / (1-(6047/4)*u)`. Under the stated unitary-chart, completed-output defect and inherited output-grid premises, `u <= 2^(-F-h-9)` permits exact private-zero recovery and `u <= 2^(-F-h-14)` permits exact final output recovery, where `F=f+ceil(9*lambda/2)+2` and `B<=2^h`. Half-grid ambiguity is excluded by a strict inequality.

Adds only `research/p104-retimed-error-recovery/`: proof, task/scope metadata, exact pins, receipt, forward/reverse algorithms, controls and registered replay. This is a local precision/cleanup result. No supplier, paid-profile improvement or new kappa is claimed. Actual rounded children, recovery scans/representation/movement, ownership/idle costs, the other 102 corrections and a viable complete consumer remain open. Native/tensor correctness remains inherited. Existing fixed-profile consumer-budget objections are retained.

## Task and overlap

Task `p104-side-correction`, scope key `PR2725/completed-Hilbert-defects/private-zero-nearest-grid`; scope **changed** from physical correction/cost work to a precision side result. Existing endpoint and complete-cost audits already cover the fixed profiles. This result addresses the distinct completed-error to exact-private-cleanup implication; it does not justify another construction round. [Task card](https://github.com/Arham-Tahir64/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d4870b711a8a0967df8ce2c089d978d10c3103d1/research/p104-retimed-error-recovery/TASK.json), [canonical claim/result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-18965658).

Started from main `4b82082f901945f8d0314f143576c7ad31e021fc`; fast-forwarded to `c7df0bb890cae0cc393cdd32dad19c3facc80992` before final replay. Guidance, priority 5, selected record and consumed inputs were unchanged. Scientific source: PR2725 `71d24b655c2fdddc063b9aaf285e8425ce197499`, 5,268 literal events and 358 arbitrary public inputs. Input SHA256 and Git blobs are pinned.

Nearest overlap: [PR2813](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2813) certifies exact internal-grid arithmetic; this computes completed-operation perturbations and recovery. [PR2503](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2503) treats a different 4,058-event private-macro dual with nonzero-discard semantics. The operand-weighted-feedback package supplies the credited method on a different forward word; no constants transfer. The current fixed-profile cost obstruction remains applicable.

Submission overlap refresh reports complete pagination for 491 open PRs and 1,522 Discussion records. Arbitrary diffs, unpublished work and complete closed-PR bodies are outside coverage; no match is not proof of novelty.

## Validation

macOS arm64 / CPython 3.12.14 and 3.14.7, standard library only:

- Forward and reverse calculations agree on every non-lifetime cut (5,252) and all 70,311 nonzero final input/error coefficients. Five independent-input/defect bounds have attaining literal fixtures.
- All eight private nonzero-residual fixtures recover inside the strict radius. Half-grid ambiguity, outside-radius failure, omitted cleanup, incompatible chart, wrong coefficient, source and receipt corruptions are covered. Exported private errors remain in public responses.
- Registered replay, six behavioral groups normally and optimized, Python 3.14 optimized replay, warning-as-error source compilation, retained PR2725 dense/native audit and exact committed-byte preflight pass.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-retimed-error-recovery
```

[Validation and limits](https://github.com/Arham-Tahir64/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d4870b711a8a0967df8ce2c089d978d10c3103d1/research/p104-retimed-error-recovery/VALIDATION.md). The tensor/recovery implication is written and conditional. No selected cold replay, Linux/hosted-CI pass, formal-kernel proof or full recursive implementation is claimed.

## Credit

Credit Vasek/flyingviper and PR2725 for the word; Nick Petalas/PR2813 for its grid binding; Adam Gall/PR2096 and ywz65's operand-weighted-feedback/private-macro-dual work for the error framework; commdata2338/PR2662, ywz65/PR2586, Ross Richardson and the retained E8/native/compiler lineage. Frozen sources remain unchanged; new material is Apache-2.0. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation and checks; separate algorithms by the same assistant, no independent human review.

## Open next questions

[Structured next questions](https://github.com/Arham-Tahir64/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d4870b711a8a0967df8ce2c089d978d10c3103d1/research/p104-retimed-error-recovery/TASK.json): bind an actual rounded native child, including wrappers and cancellation inputs, to the relative completed-output Hilbert contract; then price one viable owner window's representation and recovery scans. Per-component/absolute errors alone do not establish this premise, and precision constants alone do not overcome the existing consumer-cost screen.
